accessibility.title: LZ76 factorization of a binary sequence
accessibility.description: The binary sequence 1000110011101 has five factors: 1, 0, 001, 1001 and 1101. Dots mark factor boundaries. Curved arrows alternate above and below the sequence. The highlighted prefix 100 spans earlier factor boundaries; adding 1 gives the new factor 1001.
accessibility.social_description: Binary LZ76 factorization: 1·0·001·1001·1101. Curved arrows mark the five factors; the highlighted prefix 100 crosses earlier factor boundaries. Entropy, effective measure complexity and information distance for Python, Rust and the command line.
